name: The Putrid Sink
apply: applyExitsPatch(world, patch) from apply_exits_patch.js on the generated sink world, after the scene is built and before it is cached. Idempotent (world.exitsPatch marker).
schema: live generated world object (sc(zone) in the routes bundle): w,h, tiles[] (row-major, i=y*w+x, enum Grass0 Grass2 1 Dirt2 Sand3 Sand2 4 Stone5 Road6 Plaza7 Water8 Bridge9 Plank10 Wall11 Cave12 Rug13 Blood14), solid[] (0/1), exits[{x,y,to,sx,sy}], props[{kind,x,y,style?,w?,...}]. tiles_set/solid_set rows = [x,y,old,new]: apply only if the current value == old (else warn and skip).

exits_set.why: mires moved its sink exit to (0.6,15.5); arrivals from here now land just inside it at (3.4,15.5). This zone's own exit tile, tiles and props are unchanged.
